_comment: Hooks the PLUGIN activates for everyone who installs it (Lot 5).
Plugin hooks have no opt-in step: whatever is listed here runs for every
user of the plugin. Only hooks that are read-only, that make no network
call, that never exit 2 (which would block the user's turn), and that are
verified silent no-ops for someone with no vault configured, belong here.
The briefing hook joined this set in the `registre de liaisons` lot: it is
the surface that makes a workspace→vault binding visible, and the one-time
import of existing .env hints is only defensible because a binding the
import got wrong announces itself at the start of every session. Shipping
the import for everyone and the briefing for a few would be shipping the
